hints.title: Subarray Reduction Principle
hints.text: Replacing a subarray with its maximum value collapses any sequence into its maximum value.

hints.title: Running Maximum Retention
hints.text: An element can form a distinct member in the non-decreasing array if and only if it is at least as large as the maximum seen before it.

hints.title: Greedy Chain Length
hints.text: Count each element that establishes a new running maximum value.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass checks and updates running prefix maximum.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recursive subarray replacement branching yields exponential states.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Scalar tracking eliminates need for auxiliary storage.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Recognize that greedy prefix maximum transitions maximize final array length.
